title: Schedule of Liquidated Damages and Termination Notice - Beacon Ridge C&I
content:
Early termination of Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts is compensated by liquidated damages measured per remaining contracted kWh, subject to a minimum fee. The rate and the minimum differ by structure; the method, the usage basis and the notice period are common to all six.

## Rates and minimums

| Structure | Liquidated damages per remaining contracted kWh | Minimum early termination fee |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | $0.0020 | $250.00 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | $0.0050 | $500.00 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | $0.0060 | $750.00 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | $0.0070 | $1000.00 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | $0.0080 | $1000.00 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | $0.0090 | $1000.00 |

Rates are stated in US dollars per kWh to four decimals; minimums in US dollars to two decimals.

## Terms common to every structure

| Item | Every structure |
|---|---|
| Method | liquidated damages per kWh |
| Estimate of remaining kWh | annual kWh usage prorated by the remaining months |
| Remaining months counted when an executed contract is terminated before supply starts | the full term |
| Written notice required before an early termination takes effect | 30 calendar days |

## Points of reading

- The per-kWh rate rises from Real-Time Index ($0.0020) to Fixed All-In Renewable ($0.0090).
- The three structures with a $1000.00 minimum are Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through, Fixed All-In and Fixed All-In Renewable.
- The 30-day notice period is a count of calendar days.
